lessons.text: For a scanned vendor invoice, open the AP mailbox email with the invoice attachment, download/read it, then look up the vendor in ERP using GET /vendors?q=<vendor name> and GET /vendors/<vendor_id> to capture vendor_id and registered email_domain; validate the sender email domain exactly matches email_domain before any data extraction or duplicate check.
ERP GUI sessions can expire while on /erp/bills/new; if clicking 'Post payable' returns HTTP 500, re-open /erp/bills/new, sign in again, refill all fields, then retry.

After vendor lookup, check for an existing bill using GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>; if the result is empty, record a new payable in /erp/bills/new, otherwise report the existing bill ID and status.

The ERP 'New payable' form uses fields 'Total payable (INR, incl. tax)', 'Supplier ref #', 'Supplier', and 'Payment date'; posting displays the bill at /erp/bills/<bill_id> where 'Schedule payment' schedules payment.
Globex Logistics LLP is vendor V002 in the ERP vendor master with registered email_domain globex-logistics.in, and the AP lead's email is priya.nair@kestrel.in.
